mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_dislikes cd WHERE cd.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS dislikeCount FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id

SELECT c.*, u.username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_dislikes cd WHERE cd.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS dislikeCount FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}

SELECT c.*, u.username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_dislikes cd WHERE cd.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS dislikeCount FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY c.created_at

SELECT c.*, u.username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_dislikes cd WHERE cd.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS dislikeCount FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (article_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{content})
INSERT INTO reports (comment_id, user_id, reason) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{reason})
